blocks.title: Virtualization
blocks.text: Virtualization ek physical machine ko kai virtual machines chalane deti hai, har ek ka apna operating system aur applications, jaise woh alag computer ho.
Is se hardware ka behtar istemal, kam laagat aur aasan aur lachakdar intezam hota hai: ek computer kai ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Virtualization cloud provider ka paisa kaise bachati hai?
blocks.explanation: Ek taqatwar server kai gahakon ki virtual machines chala sakta hai, to kam physical machines khareedni, chalani aur sambhalni parti hain.

items: Virtualization: ek physical machine, kai virtual machines.
